BEL.name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
BEL.one_line: Bharat Electronics is a structurally advantaged, debt-free defence-electronics incumbent whose 29% operating margin and 36% ROCE are real but have converted into cash at only 0.44x reported profit over three years, while the share price sits 67.5% to 83.7% above every fair value our DCF model produces across all scenarios and sensitivities.

HAL.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd
HAL.one_line: HAL is a certified monopoly overhaul annuity attached to a Rs 46,192 cr customer-funded treasury, wrapped around a new-build programme that has delivered none of the 35 fighters contractually due across three years - and its share price of Rs 4,905 implies about 62.5% annual sales growth for five years against a nine-year record of 7.0%, a gap that no scenario, discount rate or sensitivity cell in our model can bridge.

QLINE.name: Q-Line Biotech Ltd
QLINE.one_line: Q-Line Biotech's move into reagent manufacturing is real and its FY26 margin gains are audited, but about two-thirds of revenue goes to a promoter partnership, three years of profit have not turned into cash, and at Rs 726 the share trades above even our model bull value of Rs 382.9 while implying about 45% annual sales growth for five years.

VIMTALABS.name: Vimta Labs Ltd
VIMTALABS.one_line: Vimta Labs is a well-financed, cleanly accounted contract research and testing business with two genuinely regulator-conferred franchises and a four-year record of margin and export expansion, but it discloses neither segments, order book, customer concentration nor utilisation, its largest shareholder at 19.72% is a competitor it names on its own calls, and every fair value our model produces sits more than 80% below the traded price.
